name: seated-knees-up-export
js: const object=v.scene.getObjectByName('swap'),clip=object.__reactorClips.find(c=>c.name==="Sit Knees Up");if(!clip)throw Error('Missing saved pose');const mixer=new THREE.AnimationMixer(object);mixer.clipAction(clip).play();mixer.setTime(.85);object.updateMatrixWorld(true);return {target:[0, 0.5, 0.15],savedClip:clip.name};
